title: JMS to AlchemyQueue bridge and durable SWIM ingress
summary: CivicPort consumes Java-neutral durable JMSBridgeMessage evidence from Queue Fabric. The side-by-side JMS bridge owns Java/BSF/JNDI/provider lifecycle and Secret Broker credential leases; CivicPort journals before Queue ACK and then parses rich SWIM XML.
invariants: CivicPort never directly connects to JMS.
JMS provider URL/connection factory/destination/VPN are bridge-side connection authority; username/password material belongs behind Secret Broker references/leases.
The durable bridge message identity is alchemy.jms.message/0.1 on the current TEXT path.
CivicQueueIngestor appends Civic evidence before ACK.
Crash after Civic journal append but before ACK is recovered by Queue Fabric redelivery plus Civic duplicate recognition; this is at-least-once with idempotent local evidence, not XA.
Same JMS source identity with different evidence is SOURCE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT and must not be ACKed as a duplicate.
SWIM XML parsing begins only from the frozen CivicQueueDocument.
procedure: Receive/persist/settle JMS in the bridge, not CivicPort.
Freeze bridge envelope into CivicQueueDocument and append CivicQueueJournal.
ACK only after durable journal success or exact duplicate recognition.
Parse rich XML and semantic projections after the durability handoff.

provenance.claim: JMS bridge separation, Secret Broker boundary, append-before-ACK recovery and journal integrity.
JMS TextMessage evidence definition, SWIM XML/disclosure metadata and current dependency pins.
Historical side candidate documents the generic Java boundary and inbound at-least-once/idempotent insertion architecture.
Historical side candidate established the Secret Broker credential lease boundary and endpoint-authority separation later absorbed by the consolidated bridge line.
